firestore.reasoning: The Firestore structure is designed to support the SalesPro Hub application, focusing on customer management, concern analysis, and a knowledge base. It follows the principles of Authorization Independence, Structural Segregation, and Access Modeling for security and scalability.  Each entity has a dedicated collection. Customer-owned data (Interactions, Concerns) resides in subcollections under the /customers/{customerId} path to leverage path-based security. This promotes clear ownership and avoids complex queries. KnowledgeBaseArticles are stored in a global collection, reflecting their broad accessibility. This design ensures QAPs are met by segregating data based on access requirements and using path-based ownership for customer-specific data.
